test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 08 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'

If Tom was here, / he could have / solved the issue.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 2'****.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error in this sentence is in the segment **"If Tom was here."**
 
• In conditional sentences referring to hypothetical or unreal situations,** "were"** is used instead of **"was."**
 
• The correct segment should be **"If Tom were here.**"
 
• The rest of the sentence is grammatically correct.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is:* 'If Tom were here, he could have solved the issue.'*
